description: An open-air sea-level beach camp: sand shore rising from a ragged tide line, a campfire ring with log benches (the relight fixture), two wool/fence A-frame tents, a barrel supply stack, a lantern class post, and a plank gangplank jetty reaching over the water toward the offshore galley. The entry set-piece for the nobodys-cave-island remake, with a tutorial surf-wave spawn on dry sand at the water's edge.

tags.era_style: bronze-age Aegean shore camp, vanilla carpentry

style_fit.rationale: The purpose-built sea-level entry for the nobodys-cave-island remake (spec-0013): sand shore, class-selection spot, crew mannequin stands, and a gangplank framing the offshore galley from minute one. Flood-safe by construction (walk plane one block above the waterline), so the tutorial surf-wave anchor is dry standable sand. Open-air, sky-lit, renders clean at 1.21.11.
